instruction_delivery: Each case receives its own unchanged detailed source captions at the four phase boundaries; no future instruction is exposed. First/third locomotion directions balanced/opposed; phase2 is stationary-root body movement, not Stand still; phase4 forward locomotion.

goals.target_pose: valid low-arm real initial pose, no stretching or high kicks
goals.end_CE: selected joint 3D FK distance at deadline only

cohort.selection: real source captions and initial GT geometry only, never generated scores
cohort.scope: new composed G1 interactive tasks initialized from retargeted HumanML3D test; not canonical HumanML3D or natural40s clips

model_roles.Minimal: ablation only, not a main baseline

metrics.direction: Coarse root-motion-state agreement with the paired real reference (forward/backward/stationary). Not full command success or proof of upper-body instruction completion; paired-caption R supplies supplementary semantics.
metrics.FID: FP64 L2-normalized52-frame features versus the same phase-paired real GT distribution; duplicate reference families disclosed, unique family counts and finite-sample caveat retained.
metrics.retrieval: Original frozen paired-caption native T2M retrieval: one GT-paired query per distinct detailed caption per phase; exactly32 same-window generated candidates, three fixed pools4101/4102/4103, two frozen HumanML3D R0 heads, three generator noises; R1/R2/R3 retained. No real-negative anchored R3ref.
metrics.retrieval_disclosure: This anchored retrieval protocol differs from all-generated-pool R@3. Never silently replace the old scores or call it the canonical leaderboard.
metrics.retrieval_exclusions: exclude same-action positives from negatives using GT labels only, not generator similarities
metrics.latency: batch1,2 complete warmups,32 fixed timed inputs, admitted kernels only; report model+decode and text-update time separately

conditions: rebuild from last196 real accepted frames only
history_utility.rebuild_contract: replay accepted latents and their original text/coordinates without resampling; retain same current pose, decoder prefix, future targets and next-window noise; verify full-history replay reproduces carry before using truncated replay
history_utility.controls: apply matching reconstruction at early and late boundaries; compare full-replay control and ordinary current-command behavior
history_utility.interpretation: utility of information earlier than local history; not proof of explicit episodic recall or understanding repeat-the-first-gesture

qualification.shared_short_primitive_probe: document execution of literal walking/backward/still commands; retain failures rather than choose different task lists for each model
qualification.reference_metric_audit: calibrate actual short action/reference pools on real GT; report reference performance rather than assign85% to generators
qualification.new_mask_kernel_gate: complete output,state,RNG equivalence for root+each single-end mask on this cohort before accelerated inference
qualification.fixed_capacity: log actual future goal visibility for DiP/DART; do not claim information equivalence if the goal is truncated

reporting.one_main_table: one row per checkpoint;52f/9/20/40 groups;rootCE,endCE,command accuracy,R@3_ref,L2FID,latency
reporting.curves: window number on X;command correctness,feature quality,slip and seams on Y; mark command switches; do not call non-goal frames constraint error
reporting.history_rows: same protocol, Native full state and recent-history reconstruction as ablation rows

instruction_reference_split: Eligible HumanML3D official/project test families only after excluding generator-training and evaluator train/development. A deterministic disjoint subset is reserved for DEV gate instructions; it never contributes to scored TEST references. Initialization DEV remains original project-val.
protocol_changes: literal4commands replaced by unchanged paired detailed captions
first/third directions balanced across cases for >=32 distinct same-window text queries; phase2 stationary-root body gestures
R3ref removed; original paired-caption pool32 restored
FID reference becomes actual phase-caption-paired real windows; same reference across methods
original128 test initializations/goals/noises/window counts and model weights retained

real_reference_gate.source: unchanged paired-text v4 eligibility thresholds fixed before HumanML3D calibration; no threshold chosen from generator outcomes
